name: Trip planner
description: A route-planning workspace: an itinerary whose stages reorder, a map of the route with an elevation profile that moves a marker along it, and an assistant with a packing checklist.

props.name: map
props.description: Image drawn under the route, such as a contour map. Without one the route sits on a plain well.

props.name: party
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; avatar?: string }[]
props.description: The people on the trip, shown as avatars in the header.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. From 1024px wide it fills the viewport as three panes that scroll on their own; below that the panes become tabs and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
